messages:
anya: quick proposal for span naming & attrs for LLM requests — want a compact, privacy-safe set we can export to OTLP.

anya: Suggested span names:
- inference.request
- inference.response
Keep them generic (not model-specific) so dashboards can aggregate.

anya: Core semantic attributes (short names to keep export size down):
- rwd.model.name = "gptx-4f" (string)
- rwd.model.variant = "quantized" | "fp16" (string)
- rwd.tokens.request = "23" (int)
- rwd.tokens.generated = "102" (int)
- rwd.token.source = "user|cache|prefill|tool|system" (enum)
- rwd.kv_cache.hits = "3" (int)
- rwd.kv_cache.lookups = "10" (int)
- rwd.route.policy = "low_latency|cost|pinned" (enum)
- rwd.quota.bucket = "free|prod|enterprise" (string)
- rwd.rollout.tag = "canary-42" (string)
Notes: do NOT include prompt text or user content; include prompt_fingerprint_sha256 (salted per-tenant) for eval mapping.

kevin: I'm +1 on compact names, but prefer 'llm.call' vs 'inference.request' — history shows 'inference' gets overloaded. Any strong feelings?

suzanne: prefer dotted attrs but avoid too many punctuation chars in key names. also propose kvcache as snake: rwd.kv_cache_hits and rwd.kv_cache_lookups (flat) — easier in Prom/metrics pipelines.

raj: Compliance flag: storing prompt_fingerprint_sha256 requires salt rotation. Suggest field rwd.prompt.fingerprint = "sha256:abcd.." and rwd.prompt.salt_id = "s1". Also add rwd.sampled = "true|false" and rwd.sampling.reason = "quota|perf|debug|eval".

anya: For exporters & retention: default trace retention 90d. Put high-signal traces (prod errors, regressions) to long-term store (365d). OTEL collector should strip any attrs listed as PII; keep only numeric counts and fingerprints. Export destinations: jaeger/otel/longterm-events.

kevin: For dashboards we want model_family and model_size attributes: rwd.model.family (e.g., "gptx") and rwd.model.size (e.g., "8k","32k"). Good for rollups.

suzanne: Streaming tokens — don't emit token texts in spans. Instead emit events with rwd.stream.token_count but sampled. Also agree use rwd.kv_cache_hits & lookups, then compute ratio in dashboards; don't export per-token KV traces.

raj: sampling policy: free tier routes default 0.1%, prod 100% but with prioritized sampling for errors. Add rwd.sampling.policy = "percent:0.001" notion.

otel-bot: configured exporter: otlp -> jaeger (prod), otlp -> s3-longterm (eval)

anya: summary: adopt 'inference.request' (or llm.call if we see consensus), core attrs under rwd.* prefix:
rwd.model.name, rwd.model.family, rwd.model.variant, rwd.model.size,
rwd.tokens.request, rwd.tokens.generated, rwd.token.source,
rwd.kv_cache_hits, rwd.kv_cache_lookups, rwd.route.policy,
rwd.quota.bucket, rwd.rollout.tag, rwd.prompt.fingerprint, rwd.prompt.salt_id,
rwd.sampled, rwd.sampling.reason, rwd.sampling.policy

anya: quick thumbs? :thumbsup: if ok, I'll open a tiny RFC.

kevin: :+1:

suzanne: :+1:

raj: :+1:

otel-bot: reaction :ok_hand:
